description_en: Call the DescribeProcessList operation to view the running queries of an instance
description_zh: 调用 DescribeProcessList 接口查看实例正在运行的查询
name: DescribeProcessList

parameters.help_en:
The cluster ID of the AnalyticDB for MySQL Data Lakehouse Edition.

Call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/129857.html operation to view details of all AnalyticDB for MySQL Data Lakehouse Edition clusters in the destination region, including cluster IDs
parameters.help_zh:
AnalyticDB MySQL湖仓版集群ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/129857.html接口查看目标地域下所有AnalyticDB MySQL湖仓版集群的详情，包括集群ID
parameters.name: db_cluster_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to display the full SQL statement. Values:

True: Displays the full SQL statement.

False: Displays only the first 100 characters of the SQL statement.

Default value: False
parameters.help_zh:
是否展示完整的SQL语句。取值说明：
True：展示完整的SQL语句。
False：只展示SQL语句的前100个字符。

默认值False
parameters.name: show_full

parameters.help_en: Filter by running time. Displays queries that have run longer than the specified time. Unit: seconds
parameters.help_zh: 按运行时间过滤，展示大于该运行时间的查询。单位：秒
parameters.name: running_time

parameters.help_en: Filter keyword. Currently, only SELECT is supported
parameters.help_zh: 过滤关键字，目前仅支持过滤SELECT
parameters.name: keyword

parameters.help_en:
Sort by the specified field in JSON format, `[{"Field":"Time","Type":"Desc" },{ "Field":"User", "Type":"Asc" }]`. Values:

Field: The name of the field to sort by. Supports Time, User, Host, and DB fields.

Type: Sort type. Desc for descending order, Asc for ascending order
parameters.help_zh:
按指定字段排序，JSON格式，`[{"Field":"Time","Type":"Desc" },{ "Field":"User", "Type":"Asc" }]`，取值说明：
Field：需要排序的字段名，支持Time，User，Host，DB字段。
Type：排序类型，Desc为降序，Asc为升序
parameters.name: order

parameters.help_en:
Number of records per page. Values:

30 (Default value)

50

100
parameters.help_zh:
每页记录数，取值：
30（默认值）
50
100
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: Page number. Must be a positive integer. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 页码，取值为正整数。默认值为1
parameters.name: page_number

Command.description_en: Command type. Only SELECT is supported

Host.description_en: The IP address that initiated the query

Info.description_en: Running SQL statement. Returns the first 100 characters by default. If the ShowFull parameter is set to True, the full text is displayed
Info.description_zh: 正在运行的SQL语句，默认返回前100字符。当传入参数ShowFull为True时，显示全文

ProcessId.description_en: Unique identifier of the task. Used when killing a process
ProcessId.description_zh: 任务的唯一标识，KILL PROCESS时使用

StartTime.description_en: Task start time. UTC time. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ
StartTime.description_zh: 任务的开始时间，UTC时间，格式：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ

Time.description_en: Query task running time. Unit: seconds
Time.description_zh: 查询任务已运行时间。单位：秒
